description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Online' dashboard extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes functions for displaying online customer data, saving settings, and rendering the online dashboard view.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for the Online Dashboard extension, managing display and settings of online customer data

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the online dashboard page, loads language, models, sets breadcrumbs, gathers online customers count, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard online settings, including permission check, setting update, and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the HTML view for the online dashboard, including data on total online customers and a link to detailed online info.
